pages.body: of every project timeline is research and planning, before any code. I like being fully informed of the market and the competitors first before I start designing the system. Business instinct + supporting data is a killer combination.

pages.title: Is this the most optimal choice?
pages.body: I obsessively ask this question. Every single decision goes through a stringent review if, given the situation and scope, it is the most appropriate to make. I am very fussy with details. Some might find it to be "nitpicking" but I disagree. I think what it is is just attention to detail.
